subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

The application of the medicine seemed to __lesson__ his pain.
solution:
The correct answer is Lessen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**lesson**' means '**a period of learning or teaching**'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Lesion- A region in an organ or tissue which has suffered damage through injury or disease, such as a wound, ulcer, abscess, or tumour.
 
• *Lessen- Make or become less; diminish.*
 
• Lessoned- Past participle of lesson.
 
 
 
• Hence the most appropriate option to substitute 'lesson' is 'lessen'.
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

Correct sentence: *The application of the medicine seemed to **lessen__ his pain.*
